items.stem: A team wants to release a new version with the ability to shift a small percentage of traffic first and roll back instantly if error rates rise. Which deployment strategy fits best?

options.text: Canary deployment with automated rollback on alarms
options.rationale: Correct: canary shifts a small traffic share first and can roll back automatically on metric alarms.

options.text: In-place deployment replacing all instances at once
options.rationale: All-at-once in-place deployment cannot limit blast radius or roll back gradually.

options.text: Manual FTP upload to each server
options.rationale: Manual uploads provide no controlled rollout or rollback.

options.text: Deploying only during a full maintenance outage
options.rationale: A full outage does not provide incremental traffic shifting.

items.explanation: Correct: canary shifts a small traffic share first and can roll back automatically on metric alarms.

items.stem: Infrastructure is managed as code, but an engineer makes a manual change in the console to fix an incident. What is the main ongoing risk if this is left unreconciled?

options.text: Configuration drift, so the code no longer reflects reality and future deploys may revert or conflict
options.rationale: Correct: unreconciled manual changes cause drift between code and actual state.

options.text: No risk, because the console is authoritative
options.rationale: With IaC, the code is intended source of truth; drift is a real risk.

options.text: The template is automatically updated to match
options.rationale: Manual console changes do not auto-update the template.
Drift does not disable pipelines; it causes inconsistency.

items.explanation: Correct: unreconciled manual changes cause drift between code and actual state.

items.stem: To automate security and compliance across many AWS accounts, which TWO practices are most effective? (Select TWO)

options.text: Applying preventive guardrails and policies centrally across accounts
options.rationale: Correct: centralized preventive guardrails enforce compliance across accounts.

options.text: Automatically detecting non-compliant resources and triggering remediation
options.rationale: Correct: automated detection and remediation scales compliance.

options.text: Emailing each team a PDF policy once a year
options.rationale: A yearly PDF is not automated enforcement.

options.text: Giving every developer full administrator access for speed
options.rationale: Broad admin access weakens, not strengthens, security.
Disabling logging undermines compliance and detection.

items.explanation: Correct: centralized preventive guardrails enforce compliance across accounts. Correct: automated detection and remediation scales compliance.
